tracking: STATUS BOARD: unlike plane-delta (proposal-only topology), this register carries live per-node status + findings[] so /goal has one source of truth for completion and emergent work.
ready_rule: A node is `ready` iff every predecessor is `done`. Recompute before each cycle.

review.engineering: Role-bundle test: belief tools cannot write claim/verification/grade/report/governance artifacts. Add a runtime-denial test (current suite proves grants, not denials).

nodes.intent: Reuse the frontier-events observation ledger for typed-fact intake; no second extractor tier.

nodes.do: Read the typed facts the frontier-events ledger already emits; add any genuinely new derived fact via the capability-observations.js pattern.

nodes.intent: Calibrated belief state over latent mechanism variables (effective_permission, object_ownership, request_equivalence, gate_effectiveness).
nodes.anchor: NEW mcp/lib/belief/belief-window.js (reads CB-1 projection + auth-differential + schema)
nodes.do: Define the belief window schema, latent variables, factor bindings, provenance, content-addressed window hash; hard caps on variables/factors/size; refuse oversized with belief_window_too_large.

review.engineering: Same evidence -> same posterior; IDOR fixture yields high effective_permission mass on the attacker-victim pair, public-object fixture does not; no claim recorded from belief alone.

nodes.intent: Factor-graph sampler (the inference algorithm) + composition search over registry templates (O(K^2) pairs, O(K^d) chains).
nodes.anchor: NEW mcp/lib/belief/factor-graph.js (pure-JS deterministic sampler first; optional THRML/JAX backend later)
nodes.do: Marginal inference + information-gain estimation over the belief window; composition search over multiple instantiated templates within the prior; seeded determinism; persist belief-samples scratch (model version, window hash, seed, sample count, marginals).

review.engineering: Identical seed+window reproduce marginals; sampler advisory (cannot record claims or schedule); ranks frontier leaves/interventions, never the authoritative order.
review.field: Equal-budget A/B: sampler-ranked selection beats info-gain-only before any default enablement.

nodes.intent: Residual anomaly surfacing: residual = -log p(evidence | all_templates, seed, window); the reachable, deterministic form of class-level novelty.
nodes.anchor: NEW mcp/lib/belief/residual.js (derives residual from CB-B4 marginals)
nodes.do: Expose residual as a deterministic residual_anomaly diagnostic; two non-gating sinks (scheduler priority hint via CB-C1 + human router with a per-factor mispredict decomposition); LLM inverted to a downstream NL hypothesis that earns trust only through the one gate.

review.engineering: Residual is a pure function of seed/window/evidence/registry and replays; high-recall low-precision -> routes to a human, never adjudicates; no promotion path; nothing minted as a class.

nodes.intent: Counterfactual intervention calculus: do-operations, predicted effect, expected-information-gain ranking.
nodes.do: do-operator over the belief window; predicted-effect; per-control posterior deltas; information-gain ranking of candidate interventions; confounders as explicit latent alternatives the calculus must discriminate.

review.engineering: Deterministic given window+seed; IDOR fixture ranks the victim-object swap above re-running an attacker-owned control; public-object fixture ranks public_object_check first.

nodes.intent: Active experiment loop: instantiate window -> rank by info gain -> dispatch via propose_hypothesis -> observe -> Bayesian update -> repeat/conclude.
nodes.anchor: NEW mcp/lib/belief/experiment-loop.js; dispatches through bob_propose_hypothesis / the TaskGraph materializer
nodes.do: Advisory planner emitting propose_hypothesis Contracts (production_paths=intervention, relational_value_match=control) and consuming observed outcomes; bound loop iterations per hypothesis; full provenance on each belief update; never spawn its own dispatcher or record its own claims.

review.engineering: Loop uses MCP writers only; single-spawner topology preserved.
review.field: Equal-budget A/B vs evaluator baseline: valid-claim rate, FP rate, controls-run completeness, time-to-first verified object-auth claim.

nodes.intent: Causal support on claims + confounder verifier signals folded into the verification hash.

nodes.do: Add confounders_ruled_out[] to the claim payload; bind mechanism_id (OSS-FAM/CWE), hypothesis (hypothesis_statement), intervention/expected_effect/controls_run[] via existing evidence_refs[]; add unruled_confounder/missing_control to confidence_reasons[] folded into the adjudication hash; drop state_sensitive/intervention_replayed (already ship).

review.engineering: No new writer/artifact; no fourth evidence_refs[] home; v2->v3 bump only if a stored field is added; backward compatible.

nodes.intent: Belief becomes the intelligence behind the one scheduler/gate; residual is a priority hint.
nodes.anchor: lead-scoring.js score+rationale -> ranking.js priorityFromScore -> wave-planner.js:50 compareSurfaces; queue-policy -> SchedulerDecision hash
nodes.do: Feed belief-derived score + score_reasons through the existing score-to-priority bridge; residual priority hint re-ranks within existing caps; one gate, one band, one queue_policy_hash; disableable per session.

review.engineering: No second scheduler authority; queue_policy_hash replay (X4 determinism CI) holds; belief-assisted mode disableable per session.
review.field: Equal-budget A/B: current scheduler vs belief-assisted.

nodes.intent: Learned calibrated factor weights over typed belief features; labels from verification/claim outcomes (the I13/C13 line).
nodes.anchor: NEW offline trainer over sanitized session exports; bob_read_belief_model_info; labels from verification-round/grade outcomes
nodes.do: Offline trainer; calibrated logistic/GBT factors exported as versioned inspectable tables; calibration report (reliability curve, Brier, precision@K, lift over hand weights); exclude raw secrets and report bodies from training.

review.engineering: Learned weights beat hand weights on held-out sessions under equal budget; uncalibrated cannot ship as default; labels are not poisoned by any induced template (none exist by doctrine).
review.field: Held-out equal-budget lift over hand weights.

excluded_by_doctrine.title: machine template-induction (LLM-proposed class self-validated + promoted to the registry)
excluded_by_doctrine.reason: Dominated (brutalist-validated): instance != class validation; the falsifying negative controls are the unexecutable victim-auth interventions on n=1; promotion launders llm_inferred into verified_intervention authority; it poisons CB-B5 labels; info-gain is blind to a latent not yet in the window. Class invention stays a human-reviewed registry change.
